Holding [Grenade] consumes your <arc/>Arc Grenade to make you <arc/>Amplified and summon a '<arc/>Sentient Arc Soul' for 20 seconds.

Sentient <arc/>Arc Soul information:
• Counts as <arc/>Arc Grenade Ability damage
• Grants 5% Grenade Energy once per burst if it damages an enemy (this does not work if you have <void/>Devour active)
